notes: Stand-in data. The network is real and public (Network: RTA public timetable feed, 2021 edition); every passenger, vehicle and lateness on it is invented. Seat counts only: standing capacity is marked not verified in the supplied data. One day: nothing here was tested on another day.

stages.text: one row is one bus at one stop; rows with no scheduled time or no stop sequence are left out; a missing actual time takes the scheduled one; a time that ran backwards is moved up to the time before it
a vehicle that is not in the fleet table is given the fleet's middle number of seats and the type UNKNOWN; seats only, standing capacity is not verified
one row is one tap: a check-in (CKI is 1) or a check-out (CKO is 1); a row repeated exactly is counted once; a row with no time, or that is neither or both, is left out

a tap is given to the stop visit of its vehicle with the latest actual arrival at or before the tap; a tap whose vehicle is not in the runtime report, or that comes before its first arrival, cannot be placed and is left out of loads and counts

check-ins with no check-out are alightings we do not know: they are spread over the trip's stops in proportion to its known alightings, and whoever is left alights at the last stop; nobody alights who is not on board
each stop is put in the community whose boundary it lies inside
scheduled departures on the service day, by route, direction and stop

boardings are counted by stop, route, direction and quarter of an hour, at the time of the tap; between a stop's first and last scheduled departure a bin with no boarding is a true zero, and outside that span the stop is absent, not zero
